description: V7R-009: v7 S2 area with the extra ground pads near U5 (G, H, J) for probe grounds.

blocks.text: v7 main board, top side, charger chip U5 area. USB-C socket on the left edge.
Zoom: U5, C21, C20, R32, C37. D/E = signal pins. F, G, H, J = ground pads. X = USB power.

markers.label: D
markers.legend: SDA (CH1 tip): U5 pin 6, the rightmost pin of U5's bottom side

markers.label: E
markers.legend: SCL (CH2 tip): U5 pin 5, just left of D

markers.label: F
markers.legend: Ground: C21.2, the end of C21 farther from U5 (2.6 mm from U5)

markers.label: G
markers.legend: Ground: C20.2, the end of C20 farther from U5, left of F

markers.label: H
markers.legend: Ground: R32.2, the right end of resistor R32, right of U5

markers.label: J
markers.legend: Ground: C37.2, one end of capacitor C37, below and right of F

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: the other end of C21. Never touch, never bridge to F

markers.label: X
markers.legend: USB power: the other end of C20. Never touch, never bridge to G

blocks.text: Rendered from the v7 KiCad layout (commit {commit}). Pad positions are from the layout file, so check under the microscope before probing.
